tables.name: Notable Location Type
tables.description: The broad kind of each rolled Notable Location. Subtypes are future work. Noble residences and estates belong to the future Noble system, not this table.

results.name: Hospitality
results.description: Places to stay, eat and drink: e.g. tavern, inn, eating house, boarding house.

results.name: Trade / Shop
results.description: Places that sell: e.g. general store, market, specialist merchant, apothecary.

results.name: Craft / Workshop
results.description: Places that make: e.g. smithy, carpenter, tailor, potter.

results.name: Religious
results.description: e.g. temple, shrine, monastery, sacred site.

results.name: Civic / Government
results.description: e.g. town hall, court, administrative office.

results.name: Military / Security
results.description: e.g. barracks, guardhouse, fort, watch post.

results.name: Entertainment
results.description: e.g. theatre, arena, gambling hall, bathhouse.

results.name: Criminal
results.description: e.g. thieves' den, smugglers' base, illicit gambling room, criminal front, black market, gang hideout, fence or other underworld operation.

results.name: Industry / Resource
results.description: e.g. mill, mine office, quarry works, warehouse, processing site.

results.name: Unusual / Special
results.description: Locations that do not cleanly belong in another standard category.
